title: Tomatoes With Vanilla Bean
ingredients: Tomatoes With Vanilla Bean, Olive Oil and Mint
Inspired by the Walrus and the Carpenter in Seattle.
directions: Whisk together 1/2 cup olive oil with the seeds of 1/2 a vanilla bean. Pour over slice tomatoes. Let marinate for an hour. Plate and garnish with thinly sliced fresh mint.
Also delicious with feta or chevre.
